threshold_note: Lead must reconcile Q7 ten-minute hardware play with 600-second whole-case ceiling; no hardware playable PASS while unresolved.

steps.action: Run the original installer with default choices. Record its dialogs, installed names/sizes, Start-menu entry and Uninstall registration; check C:\System for writes.
Start menu entry created by the original installer. Reach the main menu. Confirm exact edition and renderer before proceeding.
Start a new single-player game and move/attack in the first dungeon. Use sound. Record at least two named progress checkpoints and visible response to a timed input.
Use Alt+Tab to the desktop and back ten times; inspect both screens after every round trip.
Use the title's own Quit command. Verify desktop mode and compare resource ledgers with the pre-start baseline within two seconds.

steps.condition: only if installer registers an uninstaller
steps.action: Run the original uninstaller from Control Panel. Verify removal of its Uninstall key and Start-menu entries.

guest.note: f5-15C guest program: interactive defaults (Finish/Install/Next/Yes/I Agree/OK) on a settled page, the default directory and components kept; explicit steps, screen pins and the directory answer are added from the calibration run.
